The nearest distance exceeds C03's 3.227635 dB threshold, so no known condition is accepted. The figures support this rejection: Q01 combines a strong 5.3 Hz family and 60.97% sub-100 Hz power with persistent carriers shifted to about 16.161/16.232 kHz; C03 is much more low-frequency dominated, while C04 has the closest high-frequency carrier pattern but places it near 16.005–16.038 kHz and is much more high-band weighted. All reports share 10 s duration, 44.1 kHz sampling and identical spectral resolution, so no resampling or coverage difference explains the mismatch. Absolute FS levels are secondary because acquisition gain is unknown and the decision metric mean-centers log PSD.
